title: Pointwise etale neighbourhood from infinitesimal neighbourhoods
statement: Under the hypotheses of etale_on_open_of_etale_infinitesimal_neighbourhoods, every point over Z has an open etale neighbourhood.

proof.text: Apply the Artinian test-lifting theorem and the existing smoothness criterion to get a smooth open U containing x.

Use n = 0 to get etaleness over the closed subscheme J. Factor the residue-field point through J using the support/kernel criterion for a reduced source. Pullback pasting makes the fibre projection etale, hence locally quasi-finite. Its base is the spectrum of a field, so its underlying space is discrete. Every nonempty open in this discrete fibre has Krull dimension zero, yielding local dimension zero at g.asFiber x.
Apply the existing etale shrinking lemma to U and the zero fibre dimension, then forget containment in U.

lean.statement: theorem etale_infinitesimal_pointwise {X S Z : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ S) (i : Z ⟶ S) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g] [IsClosedImmersion i] (J : S.IdealSheafData) (hJ : J = i.ker) (h_etale : ∀ n : ℕ, Etale (pullback.snd g ((J ^ (n + 1)).subschemeι))) (x : X) (hx : (g : X → S) x ∈ Set.range (i : Z → S)) : ∃ W : X.Opens, x ∈ W ∧ Etale (W.ι ≫ g)
